findings.title: Required keyboard help-toggle sequence is untested
findings.evidence: Static reproduction: python3 -B /workspace/output/verifier-static-audit.py; saved output /workspace/output/verifier-static-audit.json. The full target has six numbered steps (target/verification-protocol.md:5-10). Step 3 at :7 says only "Open help using its summary control"; step 4 at :8 immediately activates Close with Enter. surface-contract.json:11-13 requires summary Enter, Space, Enter; :18 requires help-toggle. Manual reading plus the static checks finds no Space instruction and no reopen instruction. The checker exits 0 but explicitly reports "Contract consistency only; browser observations establish current behavior." No website behavior was tested.
findings.counterexample: Concrete input is the supplied 10-line verification-protocol.md, SHA-256 0a3452f02e358d8800fb26d591083deb972c5531165473990dc27007a9a9e0d4. Its actual prescribed help trace is summary-open with unspecified activation -> Close/Enter -> help-closed -> Back/Enter; no summary Space close or Enter reopen observation is emitted anywhere. Expected trace from surface-contract.json is summary/Enter -> summary/Space -> summary/Enter -> Close/Enter. The saved static audit returns summary_Space_instruction=false and reopen_instruction=false. This reproduces missing document coverage, not a deployed keyboard failure.

findings.title: Required observation-policy checks are absent from the procedure
findings.evidence: Static reproduction and full source text are in /workspace/output/verifier-static-audit.json, generated by /workspace/output/verifier-static-audit.py. target/verification-protocol.md:5-10 contains only navigation, answer-state, help, focus, and Back instructions. surface-contract.json:6 permits GET/HEAD/OPTIONS; :18 requires read-only-policy and origin-policy; :20 expects an analytics POST to be blocked with observed effects retained. observation-policy.json:2-4 permits only https://qaizen.io. No request-method, allowed-origin, interception, or blocked-effect instruction occurs in the full target. checks/check_contract.py:12-18 validates declared entry/policy; :42-43 explicitly limits the result to contract consistency. No requests were issued. Confirmation is limited to missing policy coverage. The sources do not separately mandate a named precondition or a particular interception mechanism; the original title was narrowed accordingly.
findings.counterexample: Concrete input is the supplied six-step procedure and contract. Static audit of all ten target lines returns HTTP_method_or_request_policy_instruction=false, authorized_origin_or_URL_instruction=false, blocked_effect_instruction=false, while required_policy_checks is [read-only-policy, origin-policy]. Actual artifact output prescribes navigation followed solely by UI assertions; expected artifact coverage must establish the required method/origin policy checks and retention of blocked analytics effects. This is a demonstrated document coverage gap. An actual prohibited request or an absent external guard is not demonstrated.
